theme_strategy.description: Warm cream background with pastel strawberry pink, rich chocolate brown accents, and vibrant fruit pops. Delivers a mouthwatering, cheerful, artisanal dessert boutique feel.

visual_enhancers.card_style: Rounded-3xl borders (rounded-3xl) with soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl), 1px warm border, smooth hover lift (-translate-y-1)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/70 border border-white/30 dark:border-white/10
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) with vibrant fruit-tinted backgrounds and dark text
visual_enhancers.promotional_banners: Warm gradient backgrounds (from-amber-100 via-pink-100 to-rose-200) with bold chocolate typography, micro-ribbon tags, and clear CTA buttons

customer.header: Sticky glassmorphism navigation with brand logo, nav links (Home, Menu, Offers, About, Track Order), search/filter toggle, notification bell, cart counter badge, and profile menu.
customer.hero: Asymmetric hero with split layout: left side with high-impact display title ('Handcrafted Artisanal Pops & Scoops'), offer badge ('Wednesday 2+1 Free'), and dual CTAs ('Explore Menu', 'Order Now'); right side with floating ice cream product showcase with decorative floating fruit badges.
customer.promotions_strip: High-visibility promo cards grid featuring Wednesday Buy 2 Get 1 Free, First order > ₹50 free pop, and Free delivery above ₹100.
customer.menu_page: Category tab pills (Cream-based popsicles, Water-based popsicles, Cups & Cones, Scoops, Shakes, Sundaes & Desserts), search bar, allergen filter toggles, grid of interactive product cards.
customer.cart_drawer: Slide-over drawer + full cart page with quantity adjustments, inline coupon code field, automatic discount calculator, free delivery progress bar ('Add ₹25 more for FREE Delivery'), breakdown of items, tax, delivery fee, and final payable INR total.
customer.checkout: Streamlined single-page or two-step checkout with delivery/pickup toggle, PIN code coverage validator, saved address selector, delivery instructions, time slot picker, payment method with simulated 'Online Payment Pending' state and Cash on Delivery.
customer.order_tracking: Interactive visual status timeline: Pending confirmation -> Accepted -> Preparing -> Ready for pickup / Out for delivery -> Delivered. Live status updates badge and order summary.

admin.sidebar: Fixed left navigation sidebar with dark chocolate background, brand mark, navigation items (Overview, Orders, Menu Management, Inventory, Coupons, Promotions, Business Settings, Audit Log).
admin.dashboard_grid: Bento high-density grid featuring today's order counters, live sales in ₹, pending orders alert table with auto-refresh toggle, top bestsellers, and monthly revenue chart.
admin.order_management: Filterable table with real-time status buttons (Accept, Reject, Mark Preparing, Ready, Out for Delivery, Complete, Refund), modal detail view, order item list, print receipt generator.
admin.product_crud: Grid/List switcher with image upload preview, variant builder (Flavours, Sizes), price input in ₹, stock counter, allergen checkboxes, and instant active toggle.

testing_and_attributes.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement JS/JSX frontend files (not TSX). Ensure all imports map to .js or .jsx components.
Use Lucide-react for icons and Framer Motion for smooth lightweight animations.
Ensure all prices display in INR (₹) and timestamps use Asia/Kolkata context.
Use Sonner for toasts (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or jsx).
Keep header nav sticky with non-transparent background / backdrop blur.
Ensure full admin panel functionality at /admin path with complete management tools.
